title: app-showcase: the task-desk page saves a record from its drawer or modal with no success toast
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect against the write-feedback convention (every landed write gets visible feedback naming the record), found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8). Two runners met it independently.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase and sign in as admin. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/page/showcase_task_desk`.
2. Drawer edit: click a task row, change Priority, then Save. The network shows `PATCH /api/v1/data/showcase_task/ID` 200.
3. Modal create: click "+ New task", fill Title and Project, then Create. The network shows `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task` 201.
4. Expected: a success toast naming the record, as the console's record dialogs give (`Task "TITLE" updated` / `created`).
5. Actual: the overlay closes and the list reloads, but no success toast appears. Reproduced twice for each path.

## Mechanism
The page's `afterWrite` only closes the overlay and bumps its reload counter. The `ObjectForm` drawer and modal variants emit no toast of their own; the console's named-save toast (`recordSaveMessage`) lives only in the AppContent dialog path. Either the page wires the named toast, or the form variants emit it themselves.
